concerns.text: Task T035-REF-ANNOTATE implements a deterministic hash-based proxy to generate 'ground_truth_score' (simulating human scores). This directly violates Spec FR-015 and SC-006 which mandate that the 'Human Evaluation Proxy' must be derived from 3 independent human raters scoring real trajectories. The task list lacks a mechanism to ingest real human scores (from T035-HUMAN-EXECUTE) into the analysis pipeline (T047), leaving the primary success criterion untestable.

Tasks T020 (Inference-Only Pass) and T048 (Teacher Distribution Averaging) are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). Spec FR-014 and FR-003 require the 'Teacher Distribution' (average logit distribution) to be computed via an Inference-Only Pass before training. Without these tasks completed, the core AntiSD signal (FR-003) cannot be computed, blocking User Story 2.

Task T017 (Context Simulator) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). Spec FR-002 and US-1 require the system to simulate the 'privileged context' by sampling one rationale and retaining the rest. The 'Analyze Report' notes that `data/context_splits.json` is missing. Without this artifact, T020 (Inference-Only Pass) and subsequent training tasks cannot execute.

Task T006 (Pre-Study Power Analysis) is marked complete, but there is no explicit task to verify the *final* sample size (N) after data filtering (T016) meets the SC-007 requirement of N ≥ 30. The spec requires confirming sample size sufficiency *after* filtering, not just pre-study estimation. A verification task is missing.

Task T035-HUMAN-EXECUTE is a manual step (recruit raters), but the pipeline depends on T035-REF-ANNOTATE (simulated scores) for T047. The task list fails to define an automated gate or verification step to ensure the manual CSV (T035-HUMAN-EXECUTE) is actually generated and used instead of the simulated data, creating a logical gap in the workflow.
